title: About me
intro: I'm a Systems Analysis and Development student at FATEC Ipiranga and hold a technical degree in Systems Development from ETEC. I'm currently an Intelligence and Automation intern at Greystar, where I build full stack applications and automations based on the needs of each team.
interests: I like to understand the problem behind each application and to build solutions that are organized, sustainable and useful in the real world. My interests are software architecture, backend engineering, cloud, security and code quality.
